parameter_description: Selects the tone group, paired with Program Change.
Sets the value of the parameter most recently selected by RPN.
notes: Only meaningful after an RPN has been selected with CC 101 and CC 100.

parameter_description: Applies the tone's assigned modulation depth.
Sets the time taken for the pitch to glide between notes.
Sets the part's volume.
Sets the part's stereo position.
Sets the part's expression level, scaling Volume.
Adjusts the tone colour of the current tone.
notes: Specific to the RD-2000; not part of the general MIDI controller set.

parameter_description: Extends the resolution of the following Note-on velocity.
notes: Sent immediately before a Note-on to add fractional velocity resolution.

parameter_description: Sustains the notes that are held when the pedal is pressed.
notes: The manual gives the range as 0-127 without documenting an on/off split, unlike Portamento, Sostenuto and Legato Footswitch.

parameter_description: Switches portamento on or off.
Sustains only the notes already sounding when the pedal is pressed.
Softens the tone.
notes: The manual gives the range as 0-127 without documenting an on/off split.

parameter_description: Switches legato playing on or off.
Glides from a specified source note to the next note played.
notes: The value is the source note number. A note-on received immediately afterwards glides from that note.

parameter_description: Offsets the tone's stored resonance value.
Offsets the tone's stored release time value.
Offsets the tone's stored attack time value.
Offsets the tone's stored cutoff value.
Offsets the tone's stored decay time value.
Offsets the tone's stored vibrato rate value.
Offsets the tone's stored vibrato depth value.
Offsets the tone's stored vibrato delay value.
Sets how much of the part is sent to the reverb.
Sets how much of the part is sent to the chorus.
Selects a Registered Parameter, whose value is then set with Data Entry.
notes: Five RPNs are received: 00H 00H Pitch Bend Sensitivity (0-24 semitones, LSB ignored), 00H 01H Channel Fine Tuning, 00H 02H Channel Coarse Tuning (-48 to +48 semitones, LSB ignored), 00H 05H Modulation Depth Range, and 7FH 7FH RPN Null. This format has no RPN columns, so the numbers are recorded here.

parameter_description: Silences all notes sounding on the channel.
notes: Sent with a third byte of 00H.

parameter_description: Returns the channel's controllers to their reset values.
notes: Sent with a third byte of 00H.

parameter_description: Releases all notes held on the channel.
notes: Notes held by Hold 1 continue to sound.

parameter_description: Treated as All Notes Off.
notes: The same processing is carried out as when All Notes Off is received.

parameter_description: Treated as All Notes Off; Omni mode is not turned on.
notes: The same processing is carried out as when All Notes Off is received.

parameter_description: Sets the part to mono and performs All Notes Off.
Sets the part to poly and performs All Notes Off.
